title: Honeyed Crunchy Oaxacan Pork Quesadilla
description: A savory pork quesadilla glazed with honey and spicy Oaxacan seasonings, finished with a crunchy puffed rice topping for a sweet and salty date‑night treat.
instructions: Trim fat from pork shoulder and cut into 1-inch cubes.
In a bowl mix honey, dried apricots, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add pork cubes to the bowl, toss to coat, and set aside to marinate for 10 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and sauté minced garlic and diced onion until translucent.
Add the marinated pork to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Transfer pork to a baking dish and bake at 180°C for 25 minutes, or until tender.
While pork bakes, shred the cheddar cheese and set aside.
Heat a second skillet over medium heat, add a tortilla, sprinkle half the shredded cheese, and place another tortilla on top.
Cook until the bottom tortilla is golden, then flip and add the cooked pork, remaining cheese, and spoonfuls of puffed rice on top.
Serve each quesadilla on a talavera plate, garnish with a drizzle of honey and a squeeze of lime if desired.
